{
  "name": "codemode",
  "version": "0.6.0",
  "description": "One codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the session's tools, and only the script's output returns.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Evaldo Klock"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ejklock/claude-code-mode",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ejklock/claude-code-mode",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "codemode",
    "code-mode",
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "tool-calling",
    "token-efficiency",
    "pi",
    "quickjs"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "mcpCodemode": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "MCP servers behind codemode",
      "description": "Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model reaches only through the codemode tool.",
      "default": []
    },
    "mcpDeferred": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "MCP servers deferred",
      "description": "Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model loads on demand through tool search.",
      "default": []
    },
    "mcpDirect": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "MCP servers direct",
      "description": "Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model sees with their full schemas every turn.",
      "default": []
    },
    "mcpHidden": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "MCP servers hidden",
      "description": "Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model does not see at all.",
      "default": []
    }
  }
}
